item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I think this is in dire need of revisions for clarity. I found myself re-reading sentences and paragraphs because I wasn't sure how they led into one another. One recurring issue I had was that some sentences seemed like non-sequiturs or ignored prior events (intentionally or otherwise). Now, this issue with understanding might be the fault of mine, but prose should be logical and coherent, or it isn't serving its purpose.

Also, why did Watson destroy the Way and leave Stewart trapped inside? That seems reckless on her part.
